description: A 2.5° × 2.5° gridded drought/flood grades dataset for eastern China during the last millennium is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zhixin Hao et al. Hydroclimate reconstruction for the last millennium helps explain the differences in hydroclimate extremes and their causes under cold/warm conditions. In this study, the first gridded drought/flood grades (D/F grades) dataset in eastern China (EC) during the last millennium was generated. This D/F grades dataset mainly consisted of two components. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2023. Formats: ZIP, MATLAB. The data are held in World Data Center for Climate (WDCC) at DKRZ and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 48319 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
